annotations.title: Base wallet balances and account nonce snapshot

description: Live snapshot of any address on Base: ETH balance, balances of major tokens (USDC, WETH, cbBTC, DAI, USDbC, cbETH, AERO, EURC) plus up to 20 extra token addresses you pass, the EVM account nonce, and whether the address is an EOA, a smart contract or an EIP-7702 delegated account. For EOAs the nonce reflects outgoing transactions only; this is not full transaction, token-transfer or trading history. Use to check a counterparty's holdings. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: Wallet or contract address on Base (0x...)

tokens.description: Optional comma-separated extra ERC-20 addresses to check (max 20)
